label: Enterprise MarTech: Adobe Experience Cloud example
exampleNote: One example of applying the methodology to an enterprise MarTech investment. All customers, people, and figures are fictional. Nothing here describes a real Adobe customer.

company.name: Adobe Experience Cloud (illustrative)
company.productCategory: Customer data, journey orchestration, analytics, and personalization
company.description: Illustrative profile for a value realization practice supporting enterprise customers of Adobe Experience Cloud products such as Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics, and Target.

customerObjectives: Grow repeat purchase and customer lifetime value
Increase owned-channel (email, SMS, app) attributed revenue
Reduce paid media waste through better audiences

adoption: Data sources ingested into unified profile

kpis: Time to launch a new journey

operatingModel.summary: Value Realization Advisor leads the outcome framework and executive value story. Adobe CSM owns adoption and product health. Implementation partner owns delivery. Customer owns data, measurement, and business decisions.

roles.label: Value Realization Advisor
roles.owns: Outcome framework, KPI baselines, executive value story

roles.label: Adobe CSM
roles.owns: Adoption plan, product health, enablement, escalations

roles.label: Implementation Partner
roles.owns: Delivery workstreams, technical build, data integration

roles.label: Customer Marketing Lead
roles.owns: Journey priorities, campaign execution, marketing KPIs

roles.label: Customer Analytics Owner
roles.owns: Measurement design, attribution, reporting to finance

maturityStages.name: Implemented
maturityStages.definition: Core products provisioned; data ingestion and first audiences in place.

maturityStages.name: Activated
maturityStages.definition: Priority journeys live in production and reaching customers.

maturityStages.name: Measured
maturityStages.definition: Incremental outcomes measured with agreed baselines and holdouts.

maturityStages.name: Optimized
maturityStages.definition: Continuous testing, expanding journeys, and value recognized in the P&L.

ad.depth.label: Priority journeys live
ad.depth.definition: Priority marketing journeys are live in production and reaching customers, not stuck in build or QA.

ad.breadth.label: Data and channel coverage
ad.breadth.definition: Key data sources are ingested into the unified profile and audiences reach the intended channels.

ad.utilization.label: Entitlement utilization
ad.utilization.definition: Share of contracted profile or usage entitlement in active use.

roi.outcomes_evidenced.label: Incremental outcomes evidenced
roi.outcomes_evidenced.definition: Outcomes are measured as incremental (holdout or agreed attribution), not only platform-reported last touch.

assessmentGuidance: Distinguish technical delivery (configured, ingested, built) from activation (live to customers) and from measured incremental outcomes. Platform-reported attributed revenue without a holdout or agreed attribution method is an estimate, not a measured outcome. Note where finance has or has not accepted the numbers.
